manifest.name: PocketPilot Text Utilities
manifest.description: A minimal, pure-computation plugin example for local text statistics.

tools.name: text_stats
tools.description: Count Unicode code points, lines, and whitespace-delimited words in text.

source: async (toolName, input) => { if (toolName !== "text_stats") throw new Error("Unknown tool"); const text = input.text; const trimmed = text.trim(); return { codePoints: Array.from(text).length, lines: text.length === 0 ? 0 : text.split(/\r?\n/u).length, words: trimmed.length === 0 ? 0 : trimmed.split(/\s+/u).length }; }
